'''Vornskr Company''' was a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that was led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Morningfire]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, the company participated in a [[Rescue on O'reen|rescue mission]] to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]], aiming to save the captured crew of a [[Unidentified Republic military exploration ship|Republic military exploration ship]]; the mission ultimately resulted in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the planet's [[Unidentified Magnus (Clone Wars rescue)|ruler]].

==Description==
A [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]<ref name="TUR" /> within one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]], Vornskr Company was made up of four [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]], totaling 144 [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] along with support personnel.<ref name="Composition" /> Sharing its name with<ref name="TUR" /> the [[vornskr]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] beast that could [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] [[Force power/Legends|using]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="Vornskr">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> the company was led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Morningfire]]<ref name="TUR" /> and a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]].<ref name="Leadership" />

==History==
[[File:Oreen-TUR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vornskr Company participated in a rescue mission on the Unknown Regions planet O'reen (pictured).]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a [[Unidentified Republic military exploration ship|Republic military exploration ship]], searching the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for Confederate supply depots, came across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]], home to the militant, [[Near-Human]] [[O'reenian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Due to the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain's]] lack of training in first contact protocols, a violent misunderstanding occurred, resulting in the capture and [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of most of the ship's crew.<ref name="TUR" />

Following these events, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] Morningfire led a [[Rescue on O'reen|rescue mission on O'reen]] with the troopers of Vornskr Company, which led to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the planet's [[Unidentified Magnus (Clone Wars rescue)|ruling Magnus]]. As a consequence, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] voted to quarantine O'reen in order to keep its population under control and to stop it from sharing military secrets and supplies with the Confederacy.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vornskr Company was mentioned in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', a [[2010]] hardcover supplement for the [[Saga Edition|''Star Wars Saga Edition'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="TUR" />
